verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a payments platform like SumUp, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented retention settings, deletion APIs, or data-erasure controls. The related items found (refunds, and offline transactions caching card data before upload) are different capabilities and do not give the user control over retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
